comment: save.c savemon() 861-870 writes each pet's edog droptime and hungrytime relative to the turn of the write, in a bones file as in any level file, and restore.c restmon() 355-356 adds the loading game's turn; bones.c savebones() 546-547 leaves a former pet its edog. A human Priestess in debug mode drops two tripe rations for her kitten, which eats both, raising its hungrytime to about 3400; she waits and kills herself with a wished-for wand of death on turn 54, and saves bones on level 1. The second game, a Valkyrie with no pet, keeps the bones, reads a scroll of taming beside the old kitten (dog.c tamedog() -> initedog(mtmp, FALSE), which keeps a hungrytime above moves + 1000), and applies a stethoscope to it: debug mode's mstatusline() (insight.c 3285-3287) shows the hunger clock moved to the new game's turn, 'hungry 3346'. Seeds, dates, characters and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
